description: NasAgri_Solution is a multidisciplinary team based in Lomé, Togo, passionate about using NASA Earth observation data
summary:
NasAgri Solution is an agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers and agricultural professionals make more informed decisions using Earth observation and climate data.

The project aims to transform NASA satellite observations and complementary agricultural datasets into understandable information about local climate conditions, vegetation dynamics, water availability and crop suitability.

Users can identify an agricultural area on an interactive map and access analyses that help them understand environmental conditions affecting their land. By combining satellite observations, climate indicators and agronomic knowledge, NasAgri Solution aims to support crop selection, agricultural planning, crop rotation and climate adaptation.

Our goal is to make Earth science more accessible and useful for agriculture, particularly in regions where farmers are increasingly exposed to changing rainfall patterns, water stress and climate uncertainty.

NasAgri Solution connects satellite data with practical agricultural decision-making to support more resilient and sustainable farming.
details:
1. Présentation générale

NasAgri Solution is a digital agricultural decision-support platform designed to bridge the gap between Earth observation data and practical farming decisions.

Agriculture is increasingly affected by climate variability, irregular rainfall, changing temperatures and water availability. Although satellites continuously observe our planet, transforming these observations into useful agricultural information remains challenging for many farmers.

Our project addresses this challenge by making satellite and climate information more accessible, understandable and relevant to agricultural planning.

2. How does it work?

The platform is designed around the geographical location of agricultural land.

Users can select an area on an interactive map and identify their agricultural parcel. Its geographical boundaries provide the spatial reference for retrieving and analysing relevant environmental information.

The system connects to Earth observation and agricultural data sources to retrieve information about:

  • Climate conditions, including rainfall and temperature.
  • Precipitation patterns and seasonal variations.
  • Soil moisture estimates.
  • Vegetation conditions and NDVI indicators.
  • Satellite imagery and environmental changes.
  • Agroecological suitability of different crops.

Python-based processing methods analyse the retrieved information and combine environmental indicators with documented agronomic knowledge.

The resulting information can support agricultural monitoring, risk identification, crop selection, crop rotation planning and the preparation of recommendations.

3. Expected benefits and impact

NasAgri Solution aims to help farmers and agricultural professionals:

  • Better understand the environmental conditions affecting their land.
  • Identify potential climate and water-related risks.
  • Compare crop options according to local environmental conditions.
  • Plan agricultural activities with better access to scientific information.
  • Support more sustainable agricultural practices.

The project is particularly relevant to regions vulnerable to climate variability, while its geographical approach is designed to support agricultural applications worldwide.

4. Technologies and tools

The planned technical architecture uses accessible and open technologies:

  • React and Vite for the web application.
  • JavaScript for frontend development.
  • Python and FastAPI for backend services.
  • Supabase for potential database and storage services.
  • Geospatial processing libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, GeoPandas and Rasterio.
  • Interactive mapping technologies for geographical parcel selection.
  • External APIs and open geospatial data services for environmental information.

5. Scientific approach and intelligence

Rather than relying on a single artificial intelligence model, NasAgri Solution follows a modular analytical approach.

It combines statistical analysis, vegetation indicators, climate analysis, agronomic rules and multicriteria decision methods.

Machine learning techniques can be introduced when sufficient reliable agricultural observations are available for model training and validation.

This approach is intended to make recommendations more explainable, traceable and scientifically responsible.

6. Creativity and originality

The originality of NasAgri Solution lies in connecting multiple Earth observation resources within one agricultural decision-support workflow.

Instead of presenting isolated satellite images or climate measurements, the project aims to transform different environmental indicators into information that can guide agricultural planning.

It brings together geospatial analysis, Earth science and agronomic decision support in an accessible platform.

7. Long-term vision

Our vision is to make Earth observation technology a practical resource for agricultural resilience.

By connecting satellite observations with local agricultural needs, NasAgri Solution seeks to contribute to more informed decisions, sustainable farming practices and improved adaptation to climate change.
